chunks: From him, from al-Nakhaʿī, from Ṣafwān, from Yaḥyā al-Azraq, from Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who arrived on the Day of al-Tarwiyah performing tamattuʿ, and he did not have a sacrificial offering, so he fasted on the Day of al-Tarwiyah and the Day of ʿArafah. He said: He should fast one more day after the Days of al-Tashrīq.

key_terms.أَيَّامِ التَّشْرِيقِ: the days following ʿEid al-Aḍḥā during hajj rites
key_terms.هَدْيٌ: the sacrificial offering due in this hajj context
key_terms.يَصُومُ: he fasts; indicating the required act in this ruling
key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: the eighth day of Dhū al-Ḥijjah, a designated time connected to the rites of hajj
key_terms.يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ: the Day of ʿArafah, the ninth of Dhū al-Ḥijjah

ai.seo_question: If a pilgrim performing tamattuʿ fasts on the Day of al-Tarwiyah and the Day of ʿArafah, can he fast an additional day after the Days of al-Tashrīq?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one performing hajj al-tamattuʿ who does not possess a sacrificial offering. If he fasted on the Day of al-Tarwiyah and the Day of ʿArafah, he is to complete the required number by fasting one additional day after the Days of al-Tashrīq.
